utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Sam, just a heads up, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, thanks for letting me know, Jules! I'll be there on Sunday to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, glad you can make it! I'll see you there on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ira! Thanks for offering, but... wait, am I really organizing that? I thought I was just helping. Could you maybe check with Quinn? She seems to have her head on straight about it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I'll swing by Quinn's later. Do you know if she's got a sign-up sheet or anything?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: A sign-up sheet? I think I saw something like that on her porch, but I could be mixing it up with a lost cat poster.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: A repair drive? I must've missed that memo. What kind of repairs are we talking about?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, you know, just fixing up the old community center—patching holes, replacing some boards, that sort of thing. The kids' play area could use some love too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, this weekend? I thought the repair drive was a couple weekends from now. Are we meeting for something else?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Sunday at the community center works fine for me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Uli. I'll bring those wrenches I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate that, Dane. Maybe after we can look over my old toolbox together—I think a few things might need replacing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So, Kira, have we settled on a date and time for the repair drive? I like to have everything on the calendar.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Eli, I think there's some confusion—I'm not organizing any repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Oh, I must have gotten my wires crossed. Who is handling the repair drive then? I just need to get the dates straight.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, count me in! I'll bring my wrenches and screws over on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Gus, actually I heard it's at the garage, not the community center. Just a heads up!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, thanks for the heads up, Bo! I'll make sure to bring my tools over to the garage instead.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, Sunday! Got it, thanks for the heads up! I'll make sure to spread the new date to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No problem, just wanted to make sure you knew. I think Leo might need help with some of the heavier stuff, though.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Opal, I heard the repair drive moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That's right, Leo—it was switched to Sunday at the community center, so no need to check the garage anymore.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, thanks for confirming. What time Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Rosa, do you think the repair drive has mapped out the most gas-efficient route? I'd hate for us to run out before we reach everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Pia, honey, the repair drive isn't a road trip — it's a stationary event this Sunday at the community center! We're fixing toasters and laptops right there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's a relief! But then how are people getting their broken items to the center? I hope nobody's walking too far with a heavy toaster.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, it's this weekend! I just mentioned it to Pia too—they're fixing toasters, laptops, all sorts of small stuff.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh good, so it's definitely this weekend? I should write that down before I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, definitely this weekend! Like I was telling Pia, they're fixing all kinds of small appliances and electronics—toasters, laptops, you name it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So lumber and nails are the priority?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, lumber and nails are top of the list. I'm checking our stock, but we might need a lot more nails.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many nails are we talking? I can check my shed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let me double-check with the organizers to confirm the location. I'll get back to you, Tess.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Hana! I was so confused—I even told Mrs. Chen it was at the community center. Let me know what they say!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I'll call the community center first, since you mentioned Mrs. Chen. That should clear up where the supplies actually are.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, did you hear about the repair drive this weekend? They're fixing small appliances and electronics, like toasters and laptops!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, I heard. It's moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Sunday at the community center? I was just telling Noah it was this weekend — good to know the details!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive! I think I was supposed to grab some paint from my garage... or was it tools?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought the repair drive was next month? Are we doing it this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I'm all mixed up again. Let me check my calendar—I think I wrote down something about this weekend, but maybe that's wrong.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, hey Sam — sorry, I'm a bit scattered. Is the repair drive still at the community center on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I think so — Sunday at the community center from 10 to 4, last I heard. Need me to help set up?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh good, thanks Sam. I keep hearing different things—so Sunday at the community center, got it. Appreciate the offer to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Wait, Tess thought the repair drive was at the community center. Are we sure about the garage location?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, actually, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center—sorry for the mix-up!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, so Sunday at the community center. Got it. Do we still have the same time?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Wait, I thought the repair drive wasn't for a few weeks? Are we doing something else this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No, it's been moved to this Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, really? Well, I guess I missed that update too. What time does it start?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, just catching up—what do we still need for the repair drive? I can grab some extra tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm actually heading to the garage to check on the repair drive now—didn't you hear it got moved to Sunday at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, Sunday? I must've missed that memo. I'll swing by the community center then—need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Eli, are you helping with the repair drive? I'm checking our supply list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'm in. But I still need a firm date and time before I can fully commit – I like to have my calendar squared away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Right, of course. I think we're looking at Saturday morning, but let me double-check with the organizers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Mara, I heard you're organizing the repair drive—got wrenches and screws if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Gus, that's perfect! I'll take those off your hands. And yes, it's at the garage, just like I told Bo.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll bring 'em over Saturday morning. Need me to help set up too?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, thanks for letting me know. I'll make a note of it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Uli! And if you need help hauling those tools over, just give me a shout.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa, I think I can manage but I appreciate the offer.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Pia, you know what time we're kicking off the repair drive on Saturday? I'm trying to get a headcount for tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I think we're starting at 9 AM, but make sure everyone's addresses are close together—we're low on gas as it is.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So 9 AM it is then. Can you let me know if you're bringing your power drill? I'm tallying what we've got.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, my mistake! I must have mixed you up with someone else. Sorry about that!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: No worries, Tess. Just making sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Still, if you hear anything about a repair drive, let me know! I'm dying to help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Faye, do you know when the repair drive is starting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I think it's at 9, but I'm double-checking with Leo because I've got my school runs to juggle.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, 9 sounds right to me. I'll probably head over after I grab some coffee—hope the wrench offer still stands if I need it for my shelf later.
